TREND_TOPIC: Rucking as everyday exercise — weighted vests worn on ordinary walks
DESCRIPTOR_STATEMENT: Adults are wearing adjustable weighted vests during ordinary walks and errands rather than in the gym, buying them for bone density and longevity rather than for strength training.
